create_pipeline_ltx2_ic_lora: create an LTX2InContextPipeline instance for video generation with IC-LoRA reference conditioning
encode_reference_conditions: encode reference video conditions into packed latent tokens with positional coordinates for IC-LoRA conditioning
prepare_latents_with_conditions: prepare noisy video latents with frame-level and reference-video conditioning for diffusion denoising
build_video_self_attention_mask: build a multiplicative self-attention mask over noisy and conditioning tokens for IC-LoRA attention control
run_denoising_loop: run the diffusion denoising loop with classifier-free guidance, spatio-temporal guidance, and modality isolation for video generation
